The '''HWK-1000 light freighter''' was a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. It boasted improved speed and performance over its predecessor, the [[HWK-290 light freighter/Legends|HWK-290]]. Even though the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] officially objected to the improved design, several hundred prototypes were manufactured at the [[Halyard 2]] [[Halyard 2|factory]]. These prototypes were sold through various underground channels in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] with many being purchased by smugglers and collectors.<ref name="FC" />
